about_the_game:
Go down without going down.

Fartcore is a third-person, low-poly, slightly cartoony 3D platformer about descending instead of climbing. You drop through a tall, stacked world full of moving hazards, sketchy shortcuts, and wonderfully weird situations. The challenge is blunt and addictive: control your momentum, stick clean landings, and reach the very bottom without face-planting.

 

Your toolkit: precise movement, tight jumps, and emergency micro-boosts with… questionable side effects. They’re perfect for rescuing bad angles, extending airtime, and threading impossible gaps - but every miracle save risks a small social catastrophe. The kind of “nobody heard that, right?” moment that turns a quiet descent into a memorable incident.

 

Fartcore is hard-but-fair:  No cutscenes, no filler - just a long, ridiculous descent built for speedrun routes  and the eternal “one more try.”

Bonus:  Shot Mode: Capture your greatest fails, slap some hilarious stickers on them, and share the shame with friends!

 

Your goal: overcome a fear of heights, keep your cool when things get strange, and touch the ground floor like a pro.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 или AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3 GB / AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: A dumb, loud third-person descent challenge with precision moves, emergency micro-boosts, instant restarts and ragdoll wipeouts. On-screen timer, respawn counter, Steam leaderboards, and Shot Mode for meme-worthy fails.
